_comment: Turkish terms chosen for the lesson lasswell-shannon-weaver. status: sourced = attested in at least two Turkish sources I opened; chosen = my own choice among attested variants or my own rendering; check = weakly attested, needs a Turkish-language reviewer. Turkish sources actually opened: Yaylagul 2006 (yaylagul-2006, chapter on the mainstream approach: Shanon ve Weaver'in Enformasyon Kurami; Laswel'in Genel Iletisim Modeli), Iplikci 2015 (iplikci-2015: Shannon ve Weaver Modeli; Laswell Modeli (1948)), Turkish Wikipedia 'Iletisim modelleri'. No term below comes from any institution's course text.

lasswell-formula.note: Yaylagül 2006 writes 'Laswel'in Genel İletişim Modeli' and calls it a 'formülasyon'; İplikçi 2015 writes 'Laswell Modeli (1948)'. Both drop one 's'; the lesson uses the correct spelling Lasswell and lists the variants in the exam card. 'formül' chosen because the English literature discusses 'formula / construct / model' (Wikipedia, Sapienza et al. 2015).

control-analysis.note: Turkish Wikipedia and Turkish web summaries give 'kontrol analizi'; Yaylagül 2006 lists the analyses (içerik, medya/kanal, izleyici, etki) and describes the 'kim' question as the communicator that holds the initiative and steers the process; the word before 'analizi' in his list is garbled in the scanned text I read. Needs a Turkish reviewer.

surveillance.note: Yaylagül 2006: 'Çevrenin gözetim (surveillance) altında tutulması'. Short form 'gözetim' used in lists. Not to be confused with 'gözetim toplumu' / surveillance capitalism in later lessons.

alt: toplumun bölümleri ile çevreye verilen tepki arasındaki karşılıklı ilişki
correlation.note: Yaylagül 2006 describes the function only as 'toplumun bölümleri ile çevreye verilen tepki arasındaki karşılıklı ilişki'; I use the short noun 'ilişkilendirme' (my choice) and record 'korelasyon' as the loanword. Needs a Turkish reviewer; a shorter attested Turkish term may exist.

transmission-of-heritage.note: Yaylagül 2006: 'Toplumsal mirasın (heritage) bir kuşaktan diğerine aktarılması'.

shannon-weaver-model.en: Shannon–Weaver model / Mathematical Theory of Communication
shannon-weaver-model.note: Yaylagül 2006: 'Shanon ve Weaver'in Enformasyon Kuramı', 'Matematiksel iletişim modeli' (spelling 'Shanon'); İplikçi 2015: 'Shannon ve Weaver Modeli', 'bilgi kuramı'; Turkish Wikipedia: 'Shannon-Weaver modeli'.

information-source.note: Yaylagül 2006: 'bilgi kaynağı'; İplikçi 2015 and Turkish Wikipedia: 'kaynak'.

destination.note: Turkish Wikipedia lists the five parts as 'kaynak, verici, kanal, alıcı ve hedef'; İplikçi 2015 writes 'hedef kitle'. Yaylagül 2006 says the message reaches 'alıcı'.

noise.note: Yaylagül 2006: 'gürültü kaynağı'. 'anlamsal gürültü' is my rendering of Weaver's 'semantic noise' (check).

entropy.note: Yaylagül 2006 glosses entropy as 'enformasyonda eksiklik (entropy)'; I use the loanword 'entropi' as the main term (also used in Turkish science) and list the gloss as alternative. Needs a reviewer.

bit.note: International loanword; the lesson explains it as 'ikili basamak' (binary digit), Tukey's coinage as reported by Shannon 1948.

channel-capacity.note: My rendering; not seen in the Turkish sources I opened. Needs a reviewer.

weaver-levels.en: three levels of communication problems (technical, semantic, effectiveness)
weaver-levels.note: My rendering of Weaver's 'technical / semantic / effectiveness problem'; not seen in the Turkish sources I opened. Needs a reviewer.

semantic-receiver.note: My rendering of Weaver's 'Semantic Receiver' box.

linear-transmission-model.note: İplikçi 2015 and Turkish Wikipedia use 'doğrusal' and 'tek yönlü'; 'aktarım' for 'transmission' is my choice ('iletim' also possible). Carey's 'transmission view' → 'aktarım görüşü' (ritual view → 'ritüel görüşü', to be settled in the ritual-view lesson).
